content: Onboarding is confusing — couldn't find how to set up my workspace.
The dashboard analytics are incredibly useful. Love the sentiment breakdown!
NPS survey: This tool has saved us 5 hours per week on feedback triage.
API rate limit is too low for batch processing our 10k daily submissions.
Dark mode would be a game changer. Eyes hurt after long evening sessions.
The CSV import feature doesn't handle Unicode characters well.
Best customer feedback tool we've tried. Switching from Productboard.
Login keeps expiring every hour. Very disruptive to workflow.
The theme clustering AI is surprisingly accurate for our use case.
Please add Zapier integration — we need to connect this to our CRM.
Mobile app is sluggish on older Android devices (Pixel 4a).
The weekly VoC report saves me 2 hours every Monday morning.
